reading: Celine Dion opened Paris Fashion Week.
She sang at a show for L'Oreal.
Celine Dion is a famous Canadian singer.
Other famous people like Viola Davis joined her on the runway.
Paris Fashion Week shows new clothes and designs.
Many big fashion brands show their collections there.

vocabulary.definition: to start an event or something new.
an event or thing that is not expected.
when a singer or actor entertains people.
very well known by many people.
to come together with other people or things.
a long, narrow stage for models to show clothes.
new styles or looks for clothes.
